note: What the Music player template does, checked headless: affrescoui test music-player.scenarios.json

scenarios.name: playback-advances-each-second
scenarios.note: While playing, the timer adds a second to the elapsed time; paused, the time stands still

scenarios.name: skip-tracks
scenarios.note: Next plays the playlist's next song from the start; previous goes back

scenarios.name: seek-in-a-track
scenarios.note: Clicking the middle of the seek bar jumps to half of the song (3:18), and playback goes on from there

scenarios.name: a-track-ends-and-the-next-plays
scenarios.note: When the elapsed time reaches the song's length, the next one starts from 0:00

scenarios.name: repeat-has-three-states
scenarios.note: Repeat goes off, all, one; on one the song starts again when it ends

scenarios.name: like-the-song-playing
scenarios.note: The heart beside the song in the player saves it to Liked Songs, and says so

scenarios.name: set-the-volume
scenarios.note: Cmd+Up and Cmd+Down move the volume by 10 and stop at 100; the speaker mutes

scenarios.name: home-shortcuts-and-shelves
scenarios.note: Home greets, shows shortcuts and shelves; a shortcut opens its page

scenarios.name: search-browses-then-finds
scenarios.note: Search shows genre tiles; typing shows the top result and songs, and a song plays

scenarios.name: a-playlist-row-plays
scenarios.note: Double-clicking a row in a playlist plays it; the row playing shows the equaliser

scenarios.name: the-library-filters-and-sorts
scenarios.note: The library's chips keep one kind; the view menu changes the sort

scenarios.name: the-queue-and-now-playing-view
scenarios.note: The queue button shows what plays next in the right panel; picking a song plays it

scenarios.name: now-playing-visualiser-and-lyrics
scenarios.note: Full screen shows the song large with a visualiser drawn as a path, and the lyrics follow the time

scenarios.name: mini-player
scenarios.note: Cmd+M shrinks Tempo to a mini player with its own controls; its back button brings the window back

scenarios.name: light-theme
scenarios.note: Cmd+T and the sun button switch between the dark and light themes

scenarios.name: italian-and-arabic
scenarios.note: The language button cycles English, Italian and Arabic; Arabic lays the window out right to left

scenarios.name: find-a-song-with-the-quick-pick
scenarios.note: Cmd+P finds a song by its title and plays it

scenarios.name: small-window
scenarios.note: At the minimum size the library, the page and the player still fit
